## Abstract

This second part of the session, following [Environmental conflicts](s_06a_Conflicts.html),
introduces methods for **accounting environmental stressors on the global level**,
including the distinction between production- and consumption-based statistics. In the
accompanying group work, you continue analysing the challenges facing your selected country or
region.

## 📚 Follow-up Reading

- @tukker2020 — a concise discussion of consumption-based and production-based
  accounting, as well as further alternatives.

### 🏆 Further readings

- @miller2009 — a widely used textbook on input-output analysis.
- @wood2020 — the authors use environmental input-output tables to describe the
  structure of greenhouse gas emissions of the European Union. They show that
  delineating an effective policy mix requires one to understand this structure,
  including the relative importance of imported emissions and sectoral heterogeneity.
